fieldsRead.programmeDescription: Study life from cells and genes through organisms, evolution and ecosystems. Wageningen Biology combines biological theory with chemistry, physics, quantitative methods, laboratory and field research.
fieldsRead.comparisonExplanation: The published credit structure is shown while the thesis-preparing course choices are verified. The prepared UCR comparisons remain withheld pending that clarification.

curriculum.routeLabel: Common programme with restricted specialisation choices
curriculum.limitation: The components account for 180 credits, but the restricted 12-credit specialisation block has not been instantiated as a verified pair for a supervising thesis chair. This is a supported credit structure, not a certified complete pathway.

componentNotes.y1-mathchoice: Example for a student entering with VWO Mathematics A: Mathematics Applied: Introduction. Students with VWO Mathematics B take Statistics 1 instead.
componentNotes.y2-specialisation: Illustrative first-listed restricted option: Practical from Gene to Protein, for a cellular, plant or animal biology direction. Other directions use Molecular and Evolutionary Ecology. The final specialisation and thesis preparation remain unverified.
componentNotes.y3-ro3: At least 12 credits must be chosen from the prescribed specialisation list. The final choices must prepare for the supervising thesis chair; this aggregate is not an instantiated course pair.
componentNotes.y3-choice: Thirty credits remain open for a minor, individual minor or elective courses.
componentNotes.y3-thesis: Required 24-credit research project. Before starting, complete at least 102 prescribed credits including all first-year credits and pass the two restricted specialisation courses preparing for the supervising chair. Current chair-specific course allocation remains unverified. Registration at least one month before starting is mandatory; discuss a project about four months beforehand.
componentNotes.y2-diversityskills: Nine-credit organismal course. The zero-credit Biology Skills Portfolio and general, laboratory and fieldwork safety requirements are separate obligations.
componentNotes.y3-advancedstats: Six-credit compulsory Advanced Statistics remains included. The thesis module’s assumed-knowledge alternative of Ecological Methods does not remove this programme requirement.
